notes.account: The page continues a discussion of recovering a homotopy type from cohomological data. It names the fundamental group, twisted constant coefficients as π₁-modules, cohomology functors with a cohomological structure relative to exact sequences, and cup products. It then considers a subcategory of the derived category, with locally constant cohomology sheaves, a triangulated structure and multiplicative operations. The author explicitly lacks confidence that these data recover the homotopy type, then expresses confidence in proceeding to a nonabelian construction involving the (n+1)-category of locally constant n-champs for every n. The page stops before that final sentence is completed.
